item.text: [{"task_id":"5c0a986e","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    out = grid.copy()","    background = int(round(params['background'][0]))","    height, width = grid.shape","    for ray in params['rays']:","        color = int(round(ray[0]))","        dr = int(round(ray[1]))","        dc = int(round(ray[2]))","        if color == background or dr == 0 or dc == 0:","            continue","        points = np.argwhere(grid == color)","        if len(points) == 0:","            continue","        if dr < 0:","            row = int(np.min(points[:, 0]))","        else:","            row = int(np.max(points[:, 0]))","        if dc < 0:","            col = int(np.min(points[:, 1]))","        else:","            col = int(np.max(points[:, 1]))","        row += dr","        col += dc","        while 0 <= row < height and 0 <= col < width:","            if out[row, col] == background:","                out[row, col] = color","            row += dr","            col += dc","    return out"],"shapes":{"background":[1],"rays":[2,3]},"params":{"background":[0],"rays":[[1,-1,-1],[2,1,1]]},"rationale":"Extend the blue block diagonally northwest from its upper-left corner and the red block diagonally southeast from its lower-right corner until reaching the grid boundary. Preserve existing cells. Colors, background, and ray directions are encoded in the tensors."}]
